# polaris_principals (Data Source)

Lists the principals of the realm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_principals" "all" {}

# Client IDs by principal name
output "client_ids" {
  value = { for p in data.polaris_principals.all.principals : p.name => p.client_id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Names of the principals, in the order returned by Polaris.
- `principals` (Attributes List) The principals. Credentials are never included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--principals))

<a id="nestedatt--principals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `principals`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) The OAuth client ID assigned to this principal by Polaris.
- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Version of the principal object, used for optimistic concurrency control.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `name` (String) The name of the principal.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value metadata attached to the principal.
